notes: P4 alternative to #7: #5 Bogolyubov 1878 (color painting, 1898 px), but it repeats the 1837 viewpoint from the Kremlin and is only 32 years from #7, so not both. #6 (‘1860’, halftone book print, unknown author) has a doubtful date. #8 Dmitriev 1911 is a thin 5:1 strip. #4 Benois is a decorative flower card with a small view. #3 photochrom is a single building (Main Fair building).
